name: American Hemp Ventures Inc.
summary: American Hemp Ventures, Inc. is a company engaged in the hemp industry, offering a comprehensive selection of hemp seeds, genetic materials, finished products, and related services. Their product portfolio features Circa 1920, a skincare solution developed for anti-aging benefits, hydration, and overall dermal health, in addition to their HempSure brand of CBD supplements. The company maintains its headquarters in Aurora, Colorado.
